<function name="SetRenderFX" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets entity's render FX. Requires the entitys rendermode to support transparency.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="renderFX" type="number">The new render FX to set, see <page>Enums/kRenderFx</page></arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Fades a entity out and removes it.</description>
	<code>
local ent = Entity( 5 )
ent:SetRenderMode( RENDERMODE_TRANSCOLOR )
ent:SetRenderFX( kRenderFxFadeSlow )

timer.Simple( 3, function()
	SafeRemoveEntity( ent )
end )
	</code>

</example>
